_README: YOUR promotions go here. This programme does not scrape offers, does not enrol in them, and does not contact any venue -- enrolment is yours alone, like every other account action.
EVERY OFFER BELOW IS AN ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE, NOT A REAL OFFER SEEN AT A BOOK. They exist so the lane renders and the arithmetic is inspectable. Replace them with real terms, or set enabled:false.
Value is computed against the de-vigged cross-book consensus probability -- never against our own model. That is why this lane is not behind the model-adoption gate.
The EV is an EXPECTATION, not a lock. Promotional value is EV-positive in expectation and can lose on any single bet.
match by 'matchup_contains': any substring of 'Away @ Home' as it appears in the live feed.

_fields.matchup_contains: substring matched against the live 'Away @ Home' string
_fields.point: required for spreads and totals; omit for h2h
_fields.base_price: the ORDINARY American price for this selection, before the promotion
_fields.boosted_price: odds_boost only -- the promoted American price
_fields.max_stake: the offer's own cap. Promotional value is bounded by this by construction
_fields.free_bet_stake_returned: free_bet only -- most free bets do NOT return the stake on a win
_fields.bonus_back_recovery: bonus_back only -- what a returned bonus is really worth to you, 0..1

offers.label: Example: underdog moneyline boosted
offers.restrictions: Illustrative terms only. Real boosts are usually capped at $10-$50 and are single-use.

offers.label: Example: 50% profit boost token on a total
offers.restrictions: Illustrative. 'point' left null means the first matching total line in the feed.

offers.label: Example: $25 free bet, stake not returned
offers.restrictions: Free bets are worth MORE on longer prices, because the unreturned stake costs you relatively less. Valuing one at a short price understates what the token is worth if you can place it elsewhere.

offers.label: Example: lose and get the stake back as a bonus
offers.restrictions: recovery 0.7 assumes a returned bonus is worth 70c on the dollar to you. That number is a judgement about YOUR conversion, not a market fact -- change it.
